AbstractText.Label: AIM
AbstractText.content: The purpose of this integrative review was to synthesize research to address two questions about phenomenology in nursing education: How has Husserlian phenomenology been used in nursing education? What is the importance of Husserlian phenomenology in nursing education?

AbstractText.Label: BACKGROUND
AbstractText.content: Phenomenology is utilized in nursing education to explore the experiences of faculty and students.

AbstractText.Label: METHOD
AbstractText.content: Whittemore and Knafl's integrative method guided the analysis of the research. Nine articles meeting inclusion criteria were reviewed. Studies addressed faculty student experiences.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: The reviewed research revealed that phenomenology is used in nursing education to understand, identify, describe, and explore various phenomena.

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSION
AbstractText.content: New knowledge gained from this integrative review about phenomenology is beneficial to nursing education.
